STEP 1 LOAD PACKAGES
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
```

STEP 2 LOAD DATA AND CHECK CRS
```{r}
ukraine <- st_read("gadm41_UKR.gpkg")
ssp1 <- rast("wc2.1_2.5m_tmin_ACCESS-CM2_ssp126_2081-2100.tif")
ssp5 <- rast("wc2.1_2.5m_tmin_ACCESS-CM2_ssp585_2081-2100.tif")
cities <- st_read(here("World_Cities", "World_Cities.shp"))
same.crs(ssp1, vect(ukraine))
cities <- st_transform(cities, st_crs(ukraine))
cities_ukr <- dplyr::filter(cities, CNTRY_NAME == "Ukraine")
```

STEP 3 BUILD STACK AND CLIP
```{r}
ukr_vect <- vect(ukraine)
ssp1_ukr <- crop(ssp1, ukr_vect) %>%
  mask(ukr_vect)
ssp5_ukr <- crop(ssp5, ukr_vect) %>%
  mask(ukr_vect)
diff_temps <- round(ssp5_ukr-ssp1_ukr,1)
names(diff_temps) <- month.abb
```

STEP 4 EXTRACT TEMP FOR CITIES
```{r}
temps_ukr <- terra::extract(diff_temps, vect(cities_ukr))
```

STEP 5 MERGE WITH CITY NAMES
```{r}
cities_tbl <- cities_ukr %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(CITY_NAME) %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number())
city_CC <- merge(cities_tbl,temps_ukr, by = "ID")

```
